name: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited, founded in 1986 and headquartered in Noida, is a diversified global manufacturer supplying components to OEMs, mainly in automotive. Its products include interior and exterior mirrors, camera-based detection systems, polymer modules, precision tools and machined parts, exterior lighting, electronics, HVAC units and compressors, and suspension components.
